facts.text: West Virginia State University's Free for Eight program is renewable for four consecutive years (eight semesters) for first-time first-year students, and for two consecutive years (four semesters) for transfer students.

sources.title: Free for Eight, Enroll at State - West Virginia State University
sources.quote: Free for Eight is renewable for four consecutive years (eight semesters) for first time, first year students. Transfer students can renew for two consecutive years (four semesters).
